A '''shakudo sword''' is the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] [[Weapons#Sword|sword]], made by smithing a [[Copper Sword|copper sword]] with [[Shakudo Alloy|shakudo alloy]]. It deals 6 damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 1000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/shakudo_sword.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Sweeping Edge]] I
* {{G|Health}}{{G|Attack damage}} Life steal: gives the wielder Regeneration III for 1 second on every hit, except against entities in the <code>#matcha:life_steal_exceptions</code> tag (armor stands, boats, minecarts and sulfur cubes).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/shakudo_weapon.json}}</ref>

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Shakudo equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Shakudo Alloy|shakudo alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/shakudo_sword.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Shakudo armor could not be crafted; this was fixed. Fixed the shakudo sword; its life steal no longer works on armor stands.}}
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats. Shakudo was renamed from "Palatinate" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Shakudo alloy became more expensive: 3 gold and 6 copper ingots became 2 blocks of gold and 4 blocks of copper.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer takes an ingot in the template slot and keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip. Shakudo intrinsics are now exclusive with the electrum and adamant intrinsics.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
}}
